en: Colorized historical postcard showing a two‑storey sanatorium building with a large wrap‑around veranda and red tiled roof. Several people, possibly staff and patients, stand or sit on the veranda and in front of the entrance. Leafless trees frame the scene, suggesting late autumn or early spring. At the top left there is a red medical cross symbol and printed text in pre‑reform Russian orthography. A small imprint appears in the bottom‑right corner.
